name: Tata Steel Ltd
description: Tata Steel Ltd is one of the world's most geographically diversified steel producers with an annual crude steel capacity of 35 million tonnes. Headquartered in Mumbai, the flagship Tata enterprise operates integrated blast furnaces and electric arc mills in India (Jamshedpur, Kalinganagar, Angul), the United Kingdom (Port Talbot), and the Netherlands (IJmuiden).

company_profile.summary: Tata Steel Ltd is one of the world's most geographically diversified steel producers with an annual crude steel capacity of 35 million tonnes. Headquartered in Mumbai, the flagship Tata enterprise operates integrated blast furnaces and electric arc mills in India (Jamshedpur, Kalinganagar, Angul), the United Kingdom (Port Talbot), and the Netherlands (IJmuiden).

revenue_breakup.desc: High-margin hot-rolled coils, automotive cold-rolled steel, and Tata Tiscon construction re-bars.
Strip products, packaging steel, and automotive sheets from IJmuiden and Port Talbot.
Tata Steel Industrial Consulting, tubes, and downstream wire manufacturing.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 62% • Europe (UK, Netherlands, Germany): 33% • Southeast Asia & RoW: 5%
moats_and_strengths: 100% captive iron ore mine self-sufficiency in India, delivering world-class low cost of hot metal production.
Tata Tiscon is India's #1 retail construction rebar brand, commanding significant consumer price premiums.
High-value automotive steel leadership in India, supplying over 45% of domestic automobile cold-rolled sheets.
Strategic UK green steel transition supported by a £500M grant from the British Government for Electric Arc Furnaces.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Global Crude Steel Capacity: 35 MTPA • India Capacity expanding from 21 MTPA to 40 MTPA by 2030

bullish_triggers: Commissioning of the 5 MTPA Kalinganagar Phase-2 blast furnace expansion in Odisha boosting domestic shipments.
Restructuring of legacy loss-making UK blast furnaces to low-cost electric arc furnaces (EAF).
Strong Indian infrastructure and capital goods manufacturing driving domestic steel consumption.
bearish_risks: Surge in Chinese steel exports into international markets depressing regional steel crack spreads.
Volatile international coking coal prices impacting blast furnace conversion economics.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
